title: Model susceptibility result
description: One record per (model artifact, scaffold, suite). Case-level outcomes live in the transcript log, referenced by digest. See benchmark/SPEC.md.

baseModel.description: Family and parameter count, for grouping: 'qwen3-8b'.

lineage.description: Provenance class. The factor the lineage experiment varies.

weightsDigest.description: Of the weights file(s). A tag is not an identity - it can be re-pointed.

sourceUri.description: Where the artifact came from, e.g. a HuggingFace repo path.

hardware.description: GPU model. Recorded because determinism holds only within a hardware class.

scaffoldDigest.description: Over system prompt, tool definitions, and suite id together.

utility.description: The benign control. Without it a model that cannot call tools looks secure.

susceptibility.description: Measured only over cases whose benign control passed.

eligible.description: Cases whose benign control passed. The denominator of rate.

byTechnique.description: Optional breakdown by injection technique id.

ranBy.description: Contributor handle. Results are verified by re-running, not by trusting this.

transcriptDigest.description: Of the local transcript log. Raw transcripts contain working payloads and are not published by default.
